```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to, from, heading, body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY writer "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY recipient "Jane Smith">
  <!ENTITY % external_dtd SYSTEM "http://example.com/dtd.dtd">
  %external_dtd;
  <?xml-meta version="1.0"?>
]>
<note xmlns="http://example.org/ns/note" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Important Note Header -->
  <to>&recipient;</to>
  <from>&writer;</from>
  <heading>Reminder</heading>
  <body>
    <![CDATA[
      Check CDATA compatibility with namespaces xmlns="http://example.org/ns/note"
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "O'Reilly">
  <!ENTITY % sys SYSTEM "file:///dev/null">
  %sys;
  <?log-target action="initialize"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:bib="http://example.org/catalog/bib">
  <!-- Catalog section comment -->
  <book>
    <bib:title>XML Parsing Techniques</bib:title>
    <author>&pub;</author>
    <?bib-pi status="active"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment-like string inside CDATA -->
      Some special entities &pub; and characters <>&'""
    ]]>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (content)*>
  <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Value1">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Value2">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>">
  %pEnt;
  <?action-pi target="run"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://example.com/doc" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Multi-feature complex document comment -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
  <content>
    <![CDATA[
      Testing CDATA with &ent2; and markup constructs.
    ]]>
  </content>
</document>
